WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_order_shares AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_count,
         1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS order_share
  FROM customer_order_counts
),
ranked_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         order_count,
         order_share,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_share DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM customer_order_shares
)
SELECT customer_id, order_count, order_share
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY order_share DESC, customer_id
